notes.title: Patch Note #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The XBOX controller button (Left Shoulder) was not working when trying to use player's freezing power which has now been fixed successfully. It should now work as intended and thank you to your patience. Please feel free to let me know if you encounter any further issue.

Patch Note:
1. Left shoulder button can now be used for using player's freezing technique as intended.
2. Some minor bugs fixed.
